content: The next year, while Shāhrukh was campaigning against the Qara Quyunlu in Azarbayjan, Ibn Turka finally obtained a hearing at the sultan's camp at Ṣāʾin Qalʿa near Sultaniyya and received a promise of reinstatement. The page gives no note for this sentence; the second apology is named as the main source for the period.
